title: Suspicious Access to LSASS Process
description: Detects a non-allowlisted process requesting high-privilege access (Sysmon Event ID 10, GrantedAccess indicating full/read memory rights) to lsass.exe, consistent with credential dumping tools such as Mimikatz or ProcDump misuse.

title: Successful Login Following Brute Force Attempts
description: Detects five or more failed logon attempts (Event ID 4625) against the same account from the same source IP within 2 minutes, followed by a successful logon (Event ID 4624) from that same source within 5 minutes.
evidence: 7 failed logons then a success at 2026-08-20T09:12:52+00:00

title: Possible Kerberoasting via RC4 TGS Requests
description: Detects a single account requesting Kerberos service tickets (Event ID 4769) for three or more distinct SPNs within 60 seconds using RC4 encryption (0x17), a strong indicator of an offline Kerberoasting attack.

title: Suspicious Encoded PowerShell Execution
description: Detects PowerShell processes (Sysmon Event ID 1) launched with a base64-encoded command (-enc / -EncodedCommand), a common technique for obfuscating malicious scripts and evading simple keyword filters.
evidence: Encoded command line: powershell.exe -NoP -W Hidden -Enc JABzAD0ATgBlAHcALQBPAGIAagBlAGMAdA......

title: Network Service Discovery (Port Scan)
description: Detects a single source IP connecting (Sysmon Event ID 3) to 15 or more distinct destination ports on the same host within a 10-second window.
